title: The Conspiracy Against Jesus
description: After Lazarus is raised from the dead, the chief priests and Pharisees convene the Council to discuss the threat Jesus poses. They fear that if everyone begins to believe in him, the Romans will intervene. Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, says it is better for one man to die for the people than for the whole nation to perish. Unknowingly, he prophesies that Jesus would die for the people and gather God's scattered children into one. From that day on, they make plans to kill Jesus [ref:Joh 11:47-53|John 11:47-53].
